requests.name: 21cm forest mock observation, PSO J0309+27-like quasars

requests.name: SKA-Low EoR power spectrum sensitivity forecast

requests.name: El Gordo

requests.name: Galactic anti-center ALP decay search

requests.name: Reticulum II
requests.review_note: Regis01: 10 h of SKA-Low on the Reticulum II dwarf (WIMP limits). Placed.

requests.name: Sun

requests.name: SKA-Low all-sky deep survey (cluster outskirts/filaments)
requests.review_note: deGasperin01: a simulated SKA-Low deep survey 'up to declination +30°', 1 h per pointing, 5,625 h. Placed on the paper's own stated footprint.

requests.name: SKA-Low deep+subband SED survey (EoR radio-AGN)
requests.review_note: Afonso01: the same 20 deg2 field with SKA-Low, ~8 pointings, ~200 h. Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Low HI absorption survey at z>3 (10000 deg2)
requests.review_note: Mahony01: SKA-Low z>3 HI absorption survey over 10,000 deg2 = ~500 pointings × 2 h = ~1,000 h. The arithmetic checks. Unplaced.

requests.name: GLEAM J0856+0224
requests.review_note: Mahony01: a simulated 12 h SKA-Low HI-absorption observation of the real z=5.55 radio galaxy GLEAM J0856+0224. Recorded as a field, but SIMBAD returned no position, so it stays unplaced (Dec ≈ +2° from its name; not used).

requests.name: proposed VLBI mapping observations (AGN jets/lobes)
requests.review_note: Kobayashi01: 8 h to reach ~10 uJy, 'enabling the proposed mapping observations' of AGN jets and lobes (SKA-Low VLBI). A proposed observation; unplaced (target not named).

requests.review_note: JingWang01 Table 1 (1,000 h set of the HI SWG three-tier survey): Medium-wide tier, 400 deg2, 950-1420 MHz, 1,000 h. Distinct tier. Unplaced: area only.

requests.name: Medium deep HI survey

requests.review_note: JingWang01 Table 1 (1,000 h set): Medium-deep HI tier, 20 deg2, 950-1420 MHz, 1,000 h. Distinct tier. Unplaced.

requests.name: Deep HI survey
requests.commensal_group: SKA-Mid HI Deep tier (HI SWG, 1 deg2)
requests.review_note: JingWang01 Table 1 (1,000 h set): Deep HI tier, 1 deg2, 600-1050 MHz, 1,000 h. Distinct from the 10,000 h ultra-deep tier (different depth and band range). Unplaced.

requests.name: All-sky HI survey
requests.commensal_group: SKA-Mid Band 2 all-sky HI tier (HI SWG)
requests.review_note: JingWang01 Table 1 (HI SWG three-tier survey, 10,000 h set): All-sky HI tier, 20,000 deg2, 950-1420 MHz, 10,000 h. Distinct from the Band 1 Wide survey (different band and redshift range). It might run commensally with other Band 2 all-sky surveys, but no paper states this. Unplaced: area only.

requests.name: Ultra deep HI survey
requests.review_note: JingWang01 Table 1 (HI SWG three-tier survey, 10,000 h set): Ultra-deep HI tier, 1 deg2, 450-1050 MHz (Band 1), 10,000 h. Canonical row for the Band 1 ultra-deep HI field; Lelli01's pencil-beam survey and Tabatabaei01's z~1 HI estimate restate it. JingWang01 p8 says this tier should target established deep fields, but none is named, so it stays unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 5b astrochemistry deep integration KSP
requests.review_note: Bianchi02: deep Band 5b astrochemistry integrations, 'a Key Science Project of approximately 1 000 hours'. Unplaced: star-forming regions not named.

requests.name: Mid Band 2 Medium-deep Survey
requests.review_note: Defining statement of the Band 2 Medium-Deep reference survey (Spinelli02 p8): ~5,000 deg2, continuum + HI galaxies, HI IM variant with the same area and 10,000 h. Canonical row for this tier. Placed on a new field quoting Spinelli02 p8, 'Most surveys expect this area to overlap the DES and Euclid regions in the Southern sky' (Dec<0; the exact 5,000 deg2 footprint is not stated).

requests.name: Mid Band 1 Wide Survey
requests.review_note: Defining statement of the Wide Band 1 reference survey (Spinelli02 p8, cosmology SWG overview): ~20,000 deg2, most of the Southern sky, 10,000 h. Canonical row for this tier; continuum and HI IM restatements in other chapters are duplicates. Placed via Spinelli02's 'most of the Southern sky' field (Dec<0).

requests.name: TNOs and Centaurs thermal survey (23 brightest known objects)
requests.review_note: Santos-Sanz01: 23 brightest TNOs and Centaurs × 5 h in Band 5b = 115 h. The arithmetic checks. Unplaced: moving solar-system targets near the ecliptic.

requests.name: high-mass protostellar outflow cyanopolyyne survey
requests.review_note: Sabatini01: HC9N detection toward high-mass protostellar outflows 'in ≲10 h' with AA4. A small per-source request; unplaced (no target named).

requests.name: SKA-Mid 10-15 GHz Galactic Plane survey
requests.review_note: Traficante01: a Band 5b Galactic Plane survey, 14.5 s × 124,000 pointings × 1.2 ≃ 600 h (the arithmetic checks: 600 h), over -180<l<30, |b|≤1.5. Only one row, so the group name is kept as its canonical tier. Placed.

requests.name: structured protoplanetary disk sample Key Science Project (Band 5b)
requests.review_note: Wu01: AA4 imaging of a larger sample of structured protoplanetary disks, 'integration times up to a 1000-hour Key Science Project'. 1,000 h is an upper bound. Unplaced: sample not named.

requests.name: protostellar/outbursting protoplanetary disk survey (Band 5, 1000h iCOMs)
requests.review_note: Podio01: 1,000 h needed to detect larger iCOMs and complex C-chains in protostellar and outbursting disks (Band 5). The deeper goal, which contains the 100 h goal (#49). Unplaced.

requests.name: Ophiuchus free-free survey (Band 5b)
requests.review_note: Guidi01: a free-free survey of a star-forming region at 140 pc (Ophiuchus), ~60 h in Band 5b. A separate band from #52. Placed.

requests.name: Ophiuchus free-free survey (Band 5a)
requests.review_note: Guidi01: the same Ophiuchus free-free survey in Band 5a, ~20 h. Placed.

requests.name: L1551 IRS5
requests.review_note: Sabatini01: L1551 IRS5 in <13 h with SKA-Mid AA4, which the paper calls suitable for Cycle 0. Placed on the named target.

requests.name: G32.80+0.19
requests.review_note: LorenAnderson01: 10 h in Band 5b to detect CRRL Zeeman splitting toward G32.80+0.19. Placed.

requests.name: G70.29+1.60b
requests.review_note: LorenAnderson01: 10 h in Band 5b toward G70.29+1.60b. A separate target from #54. Placed.

requests.name: Galactic Centre
requests.review_note: Rygl01: a ~2.5 h Band 2 pointing toward the Galactic Centre. Placed.

requests.name: W3A
requests.review_note: LorenAnderson01: 10 h AA4 Band 2 CRRL Zeeman imaging toward W3A. Placed (W3A is far north for SKA-Mid, so it may be flagged as never visible above 45°).

requests.name: SKA-Mid water maser blind survey (1 sq deg)
requests.review_note: Tarchi01: blind water-maser search over ~1 deg2 (~65 pointings × 10 h), ~1,000 h for each of three Band 5a/5b configurations, so 3,000 h. The paper also gives a quarter-sky alternative (#59). Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid AA2 compact-binary spectral-flatness survey
requests.review_note: Lin01: an AA2 compact-binary survey, 10 s snapshots of ~10,000 candidates in three bands, 100 h. Unplaced: candidates spread across the Galaxy.

requests.name: redshift-drift experiment, SKA-Mid AA*
requests.review_note: Camera01: redshift-drift experiment with SKA-Mid AA* over 5,000 deg2, 'survey duration of approximately six months' = 6 × 730 = 4,380 h (1 h per pointing). The arithmetic checks. The drift measurement needs a second epoch ~12 yr later, beyond the horizon. Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid HI survey of 150 nearby galaxies (MHONGOOSE depth)
requests.review_note: deBlok01: in the time MHONGOOSE took on MeerKAT (30 galaxies × 55 h = 1,650 h), SKA-Mid can map 150 galaxies to the same depth. 1,650 h is consistent. Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA1-Mid AA4/AA* RM survey of known pulsars lacking RM measurements
requests.review_note: JunXu01: >600 known pulsars without RMs at 60 min each, so 600 h. The arithmetic checks. Unplaced: pulsars spread across the sky.

requests.name: SKA-Mid AA* survey of known DAGN at z>3.5
requests.review_note: DAmato01: ~50 h of AA* to observe every currently known dual AGN at z>3.5 to 0.75 uJy/beam (3σ). Unplaced: population not listed.

requests.name: NGC 6240
requests.review_note: DAmato01: a 10 h SKA-Mid Band 2 observation of NGC 6240. Placed.

requests.name: SKA-Mid+VLBI follow-up tracks of triggered jetted TDEs
requests.review_note: Shu01: '1-2 jetted TDEs per year', each followed with '3-4 long (≳8 h) SKA+VLBI tracks'. The extraction's 24 h is one TDE (3 × 8 h). Over the 5-yr horizon at the lower bound (1 per year × 3 × 8 h): 120 h. Unplaced: triggered targets.

requests.name: Sgr A*
requests.review_note: Abbate01: 'observing the GC for the entire transit', ~11 h above the horizon. A proposed deep GC pulsar observation. Placed on Sgr A*.

requests.name: Sgr A*
requests.review_note: Abbate01: a PSS multi-beam coverage of the GC region, '20-30 h in band 5a'. The lower bound of 20 h is kept. Placed.

requests.name: SKA-Mid 21-cm imaging survey for higher-order statistics
requests.review_note: Majumdar01: noise estimates assume 5,000 h per pointing of SKA-Mid 21-cm imaging, for a single 4 deg2 sub-cube, so 5,000 h in total. This is a forecast assumption rather than a detailed proposal, but it is the stated requirement for the science case. Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid AA4 core HI survey of massive galaxies within 10 Mpc
requests.review_note: Rosolowsky01: core HI survey of ≥100 massive galaxies within 10 Mpc at ~6 h each, so 600 h. The arithmetic checks. Unplaced (Virgo and Fornax are mentioned only as possible extensions).

requests.name: SKA-VLBI methanol maser parallax survey (doubling BeSSeL sample)
requests.review_note: XuYe01: SKA-VLBI methanol-maser parallaxes to double the ~200-maser sample, ~300 h (6 epochs of 6 h, ~25 sources per epoch). Unplaced: masers spread across the Galaxy.

requests.name: PSR J0737-3039A
requests.review_note: AvishekBasu01: the J0737-3039A moment-of-inertia forecast assumes '3 hr monthly observations' over a multi-year baseline (Fig. 9 x-axis is years). The extraction's 36 h is one year. Scaled to the 5-yr horizon: 3 h × 12 × 5 = 180 h. Placed on PSR J0737-3039A (recorded field, SIMBAD position).

requests.name: Cen A
requests.review_note: Sawada-Satoh01: 10 h SKA-Mid VLBI (with Parkes and HartRAO) maser/absorption observation of Cen A. Placed.

requests.name: NGC 4261
requests.review_note: Sawada-Satoh01: 10 h SKA-Mid VLBI toward NGC 4261. Placed.

requests.name: NGC 1275
requests.review_note: Sawada-Satoh01: 10 h SKA-Mid VLBI toward NGC 1275. Placed (Dec +41.5°, so expect a never-visible flag at the 45° default minimum elevation).

requests.name: SKA-Mid AA4 pulsar search of all Galactic globular clusters
requests.review_note: Bagchi01: a 2 h AA4 pulsar search of every Galactic globular cluster (>150 known), about 300 h. Unplaced: many targets.

requests.name: SKA-Mid deep 8-hour pulsar search of closest 10 globular clusters
requests.review_note: Bagchi01: deeper 8 h tracks of the 10 closest GCs, so 80 h, on top of the 2 h survey. Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 2 Ultra-Deep reference survey
requests.commensal_group: SKA-Mid Band 2 Ultra-Deep continuum tier (Prandoni & Seymour)
requests.review_note: Prandoni01 Table 1 and Table 3 A.1: Band 2 Ultra-Deep tier, 1 deg2 to 0.05 uJy/bm, 4,849 h. The extraction's quote is from the B.1 (AA*) column, but the 4,849 h figure matches A.1 (AA4); B.1 gives 1,212 h at relaxed sensitivity. AA4 figure kept, since Prandoni01 says this tier is unfeasible with AA*. Separate tier; unplaced (no field stated).

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 2 Deep reference survey
requests.commensal_group: SKA-Mid Band 2 Deep continuum tier (Prandoni & Seymour)
requests.review_note: Prandoni01 Table 3, A.1: Band 2 Deep tier, 20 deg2 to 0.2 uJy/bm, 6,080 h (= 304 h/deg2 × 20). Separate tier with its own group. Prandoni01 p23 names EDF-Fornax and EDF-South as ideal deep-tier targets (recorded as field 'EDF-Fornax'), but neither resolves to a position, so the tier stays unplaced. Both fields lie near RA 3.5-4 h.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 2 Wide reference survey
requests.commensal_group: SKA-Mid Band 2 Wide continuum tier (Prandoni & Seymour)
requests.review_note: Prandoni01 Table 3, strategy A.1 (AA4, full area): Band 2 Wide tier, 1,000 deg2 to 1 uJy/bm, 12,200 h (= 12.2 h/deg2 × 1000, Table 1). This is a separate tier, not commensal with the Deep and Ultra-Deep tiers, so it moves out of the lumped 'Prandoni & Seymour' group. Unplaced: no footprint stated. The Dec=-45 in Prandoni01 is only a sensitivity-calculator assumption.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 5b Ultra-Deep reference survey
requests.commensal_group: SKA-Mid Band 5b Ultra-Deep continuum tier (Prandoni & Seymour)
requests.review_note: Prandoni01 Table 1: Band 5b Ultra-Deep tier, 0.04 deg2 to 0.04 uJy/bm, 3,146 h. The table footnote says this time refers to the 0.04 deg2 survey area, not per deg2, so the hours are correct. Separate tier. Unplaced.

requests.name: AGN-oriented Band 5a wide tier (10 deg2)
requests.review_note: Prandoni01 p17: an AGN-oriented shallower tier, 10 deg2 in Band 5a in ~300 h. Separate band, so no shared time with Band 5b. Unplaced.

requests.name: AGN-oriented Band 5b wide tier (10 deg2)
requests.review_note: Prandoni01 p17: the Band 5b counterpart of the 10 deg2 AGN-oriented tier, ~900 h. Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 5b Deep reference survey
requests.commensal_group: SKA-Mid Band 5b Deep continuum tier (Prandoni & Seymour)
requests.review_note: Prandoni01 Table 1: Band 5b Deep tier, 2 deg2 to 0.2 uJy/bm, t/deg2 = 1573 h, so 2 × 1573 = 3,146 h. Separate tier (Band 5b cannot share time with the Band 2 tiers). Unplaced.

requests.name: Holmberg II X-1
requests.review_note: Sakemi01: '100 hours of observation with SKA-Mid should allow detection of bubbles associated with ULXs in galaxies up to ~10 Mpc'. Placed on Holmberg II X-1, the paper's template source; the actual targets are ULX hosts within ~10 Mpc, so the position is indicative.

requests.name: rho Oph W filament
requests.review_note: Vidal01: a 3 h Band 5b integration on the rho Oph W filament (AME imaging). Placed.

requests.name: SKAO medium-deep Hi-galaxy cross-correlation survey
requests.review_note: Mazumder01: an SKAO 'medium-deep type' Band 1 AA4 survey, 100 deg2 in 1,000 h, for HI-galaxy cross-correlation with Euclid. Its area differs from the 5,000 deg2 Medium-Deep reference, so it is kept separate. Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 5a diffuse polarized synchrotron survey of nearby galaxies
requests.review_note: Mao01: 50 h per galaxy in Band 5a for a desired sample of ~50-100 nearby galaxies, taking the lower bound: 50 × 50 = 2,500 h. The arithmetic checks. Unplaced: galaxies not named.

requests.name: MRC B0600-399 / MRC B1407-425 cold front observation
requests.review_note: Akahori01: ≥8 h above 45° elevation on a Dec -40° cold-front source (candidates MRC B0600-399 or MRC B1407-425), Band 2. The candidates differ in RA by ~8 h, so the request stays unplaced.

requests.name: SKAO-PTA sub-array timing programme (AA4)
requests.review_note: Shannon01: 174 MSPs in 8.9 h per epoch with AA4 at a two-week cadence, i.e. 26 epochs × 8.9 h = 231.4 h per year. The extraction's 231.4 h is per year, but the PTA is an ongoing multi-year programme, so hours are scaled to the 5-yr planning horizon: 231.4 × 5 = 1,157 h. Unplaced: 174 MSPs across the sky.

requests.name: AA4 SKA-Mid HI mosaic survey of voids, groups and filaments
requests.review_note: Ramatsoku01: AA4 HI mosaic of voids, groups and filaments at ~40 Mpc, 200-250 deg2 at ~13 h/deg2, ~2,600 h. Consistent with 200 deg2 × 13 h. Unplaced.

requests.name: Dedicated SKA-Mid (AA*) TDE follow-up programme (Bands 2/5, +Low for late-time)
requests.review_note: TaoAn03: a dedicated AA* TDE follow-up programme 'of order 100-200 hr yr^-1'. The extraction's 100 h is one year at the lower bound; as a recurring annual programme it is scaled to the 5-yr horizon: 100 × 5 = 500 h. The shared TaoAn03/Shu01 group label is removed: Shu01's SKA+VLBI tracks are a different mode and are counted separately. Unplaced: triggered targets.

requests.name: SKA1-Mid AA4 CNM structure/Zeeman study of a nearby star-forming region
requests.review_note: Yamamoto01: a 100 h AA4 HI Zeeman/CNM integration on one nearby star-forming region (Table: integration time 100 hours). Candidates are Taurus, Lupus, Ophiuchus, MBM 53-55 and others, so it stays unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-VLBI OH maser astrometry of the Nuclear Stellar Disk
requests.review_note: Imai01: 11 fields × 4 h × 5 visits over a 5-yr project = 220 h in total (the arithmetic checks, and the span matches the horizon). Placed at the Galactic Centre.

requests.name: SKA-Mid multi-band Tier 1 resolved-benchmark survey of nearby galaxies
requests.review_note: Moldon01: Tier 1 resolved benchmarks, 5-10 nearby galaxies at 10 h each; the lower bound gives 50 h. Unplaced: galaxies not named.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 2 Tier 3 targeted benchmark galaxies
requests.review_note: Moldon01: Tier 3 targeted benchmarks, 100-200 galaxies at 0.5 h in Band 2; the lower bound gives 50 h. Unplaced.

requests.name: Reticulum II
requests.review_note: Regis01: SKA-Mid Band 1 sensitivity (2.5 uJy/beam) for the same 10 h Reticulum II forecast. The 10 h is stated in the same paragraph for the SKA-Low band and in the Fig. caption ('10 hours of observing Reticulum II'). A separate telescope from #125. Placed.

requests.name: Galactic Center magnetar
requests.review_note: Regis01: 10 h of SKA-Mid AA4 on an isolated magnetar (ALP conversion), placed at the Galactic Centre magnetar. Placed.

requests.name: SKA AA4 intermediate HI cosmic-web survey (1000 deg2)
requests.review_note: HengxingPan01 fixes the total at ~1,000 h and simulates three alternative designs (5, 20 or 80 min per pointing over 4,000, 1,000 or 250 deg2). One design is counted: the intermediate 1,000 deg2 survey, which the paper also evaluates for AA*. Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid AA4 Band 2 fiducial untargeted HI survey (100 deg2, 4.45'' beam)
requests.review_note: Deg01 fiducial untargeted AA4 Band 2 HI survey: 100 deg2 at a 4.45'' beam, 12 h per pointing, 1,200 h total (table value). A high-resolution tier, distinct from the 13'' tier (#133). Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid AA4 Band 2 fiducial untargeted HI survey (1000 deg2, 13.15'' beam)
requests.review_note: Deg01 fiducial untargeted AA4 Band 2 HI survey: 1,000 deg2 at a 13.15'' beam, 30 min per pointing, 500 h total (table value). A second tier with a different resolution goal. Unplaced.

requests.name: deep SKA-Mid AA4 Band 2 polarimetric imaging of merging cluster pair and connecting filament (equipartition scenario)
requests.review_note: Vacca01 concludes 'we will need to resort to deep (≥50 h) low spatial resolution pointed observations' of merging clusters and filaments in Band 2. This is the paper's proposed approach, a lower bound per system. Unplaced: the systems are simulated.

requests.name: untargeted wide-field medium-shallow Hi survey
requests.review_note: Lelli01: untargeted wide-field medium-shallow HI survey with SKA-Mid AA4 Band 2, 150 deg2 in ~900 h, to resolve ~20,000 galaxies. Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid AA* all-sky RM grid and polarization survey
requests.review_note: Sun01 restates the Magnetism SWG all-sky Band 2 polarization survey (Heald et al. 2020): 30,000 deg2, 4 uJy/beam, 15 min × ~30,000 pointings = 7,500 h on-source. Kept as the canonical row for the Band 2 all-sky continuum/polarization tier. The paper's '~2.5 yr' includes night-only scheduling and overheads, and the night constraint is not in the extraction. Unplaced: 'all-sky' with no declination limit stated.

requests.name: legacy survey of 50 nearby galaxies
requests.review_note: Lelli01: a proposed high-resolution legacy survey of 50 nearby galaxies in ~1,000 h (~20 h each). Unplaced: galaxies not named.

requests.name: SKA-Mid AA4 wide HI emission survey matching GALFA-HI depth
requests.review_note: Miville-Deschenes01: a GALFA-HI-depth survey of Dec<-15° (~75% of the southern hemisphere) in <600 h with AA4. The paper says it might run commensally with other all-sky surveys, but none is specified, so it stays ungrouped. Placed on the stated Dec<-15° footprint.

requests.name: Local Bubble walls (SKA-mid AA4 deep pointing)
requests.review_note: Miville-Deschenes01: a proposed 20 h deep AA4 pointing to image HI in the Local Bubble walls over a 1° field. Unplaced: field not specified.

requests.name: Multi-band continuum/line survey of the NSC (centred on Sgr A*)
requests.review_note: Schoedel01: multi-band survey of a 2.0°×0.4° field on Sgr A*: 234 h at 12.5 GHz + ~70 h at 6.7 GHz + 5 h at 1.4 GHz, stated total 325 h (the parts sum to ~309 h; the paper's total is kept). Placed on Sgr A*.

requests.name: Repeated deep monitoring of the NSC (Bands 5a/5b, Sgr A*)
requests.review_note: Schoedel01 'propose[s]' repeated 1 h Band 5a/5b snapshots of the NSC over 5-10 yr, stacking to ~1,000 h. At least half of that falls inside the 5-yr horizon, but the paper's total is kept. Placed on Sgr A*.

requests.name: Arches/Quintuplet comparison field (NSD contamination study)
requests.review_note: Schoedel01: 100 h for an NSD comparison field that 'can be pointed toward the young Arches or Quintuplet clusters'. Placed on the Arches Cluster (recorded field, SIMBAD position; Quintuplet is ~0.1° away, so the LST is the same).

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 2 deep SED survey (EoR radio-AGN)
requests.review_note: Afonso01: a 20 deg2 Band 2 deep SED survey for EoR radio-AGN, ~150 h (0.55 deg2 effective area per pointing). A separate receiver band from #149. Unplaced: field not named.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 1 deep SED survey (EoR radio-AGN)
requests.review_note: Afonso01: the same 20 deg2 field in Band 1, 14 pointings, ~100 h. Unplaced.

requests.name: GDIGS-like RRL survey extension (SKA-Mid Band 5a, AA*)
requests.review_note: Salas01: reproducing a GDIGS-like RRL survey (37 deg2, 451 pointings × 0.82 h) with AA* Band 5a in ~370 h, extended to lower declinations. The GDIGS area is not given in coordinates, so it stays unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid jet-misalignment follow-up sample (~60 BCGs)
requests.review_note: Gitti01: pointed follow-up of ≳60 BCGs with misaligned jets at 1.5 h each (0.5 h at three frequencies): 60 × 1.5 = 90 h. The arithmetic checks. Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 1 wide-area HI absorption survey (10000 deg2)
requests.review_note: Mahony01: representative shallow SKA-Mid Band 1 HI absorption survey, ~10,000 deg2 = ~5,000 pointings × 2 h = 10,000 h. The arithmetic checks. Unplaced: no footprint stated.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 1 component of multi-band deep survey
requests.review_note: Algera01 p4: Band 1 share of the multi-band deep field, ~10 h. Separate receiver band, so the group is cleared. Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 2 component of multi-band deep survey
requests.review_note: Algera01 p4: Band 2 share of the multi-band deep field, ~10 h. Separate receiver band, so the group is cleared. Unplaced.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 5a component of multi-band deep survey
requests.review_note: Algera01 p4: Band 5a share of the multi-band deep field, ~500 h over 12 pointings. Separate receiver band, so the group is cleared. Unplaced: only candidate fields are named.

requests.name: SKA-Mid Band 5b component of multi-band deep survey
requests.review_note: Algera01 p4: Band 5b share of the matched-resolution multi-band deep field (0.25 deg2, Prandoni & Seymour-style design), ~3,300 h over 39 pointings. The four Algera01 bands are separate SKA-Mid receiver bands, which cannot observe simultaneously, so the commensal group is cleared. Kept in place of Prandoni01's 5,000 h total (#97), which includes SKA-Low bands. Unplaced: COSMOS, UDS, GOODS-S and EDF-S are named only as candidate fields.

requests.name: Large Magellanic Cloud
requests.review_note: Chen01: 2 h phase-referenced maser astrometry toward the LMC (Band 5a). Placed.

requests.name: Jupiter quadrupolar light-deflection campaign
requests.review_note: Li01: a Jupiter light-deflection campaign of 6 epochs × 60 samples × ~10 s = 3,600 s = 1 h on-source. The arithmetic checks, and overheads are excluded. Unplaced: the targets move with Jupiter.

requests.name: PSR J0437-4715
requests.review_note: Takahashi01: 3,600 s per epoch × 30 epochs = 30 h of phased SKA-Mid VLBI on this MSP. The 'SKA1-Mid PTA MSP parallax VLBI program' label is removed: the seven pulsars are separate targets that do not share time.
